Scrolling allows natural word breaks and shorter rows, at the cost of moving horizontally to compare all fields."},"designs":[{"widths":[87,92,107,73],"strategy":"Fit all four columns within the viewport, keeping the verdict whole and giving weaknesses slightly more room while accepting dense wrapping and some split words."},{"widths":[108,145,155,73],"strategy":"Use moderate horizontal scrolling to give both prose columns room for whole words while keeping the option and verdict columns compact."},{"widths":[136,290,320,73],"strategy":"Use a wide scrolling table that keeps option names on one line and gives the paired prose fields generous, comparable space for continuous reading."}]}
